about_the_game:
ACCESSORIES PACK
  • THALASSA PRIME EPHEMERA: Creatures of the deep circle and play in your wake. Yareli Prime’s signature ephemera.
  • MERULINA PRIME SYANDANA: Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.
  • MERULINA PRIME DOMESTIK DRONE: Merulina’s tiny spawn are used to foraging on the sea bed, and adapt easily to nibbling up dirt from an Orbiter floor.
  • 90-Day Affinity Booster
  • 90-Day Resource Booster

Prime Warframes and Weapons in Prime Access can also be crafted from parts found in Relics in-game.

This pack can only be purchased once per account.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *:Windows 7 64-Bit (32-bit not supported)
  • Processor:Intel Core i7 860, Intel Core i5 750, or AMD FX-4100 (SSE 4.2 support required)
  • Video:DirectX 11+ capable Graphics Card
  • Memory:4 GB RAM
  • Storage:50 GB available HD space
  • Internet:Broadband Internet Connection Required

Note: There is no Mac or Linux client currently available.

DirectX 12 support requires at least Windows 10 20H2 (released in 2020) or Windows 11
